name: GuardOS – Pre-Shipment Risky Order Scoring: Address Quality, Return History, Pincode RTO, AI Analyst & Fulfilment Holds

parameters.content:
# GuardOS – Pre-Shipment Risky Order Scoring

For Indian Shopify brands where a chunk of COD orders come back as RTO: fake addresses, serial returners, pincodes couriers struggle with. By the time anyone notices, the parcel has shipped both ways at your cost.

## How it works
Every new order is scored before it reaches the warehouse. Rules look at address quality, the customer's return history, your pincode RTO data, courier COD coverage and India Post pincode data. GPT-4o-mini adds a second opinion and suggests address fixes. The blended score puts the order in one of three tiers.

Low-risk orders ship as normal. Medium-risk orders are held and the customer is asked to confirm, cancel or pay online. High-risk orders are held and sent to Slack with Release, Cancel and Prepay buttons. Unconfirmed orders get a reminder after 4 hours and are escalated after 24.

## Setup steps
1. Connect the Shopify trigger, and add a Shopify custom-app token (`write_orders`, `write_merchant_managed_fulfillment_orders`) as Header Auth.
2. Add Shiprocket as Custom Auth with `{"body":{"email":"…","password":"…"}}`.
3. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets, Slack, Gmail and WhatsApp Business Cloud.
4. Create **Customer History**, **Pincode Risk** and **Order Risk Log** tabs.
5. In **Risk Config & Normalize**, set your warehouse pincode, n8n domain, thresholds and pay-online link, then place a test COD order.

## Order Intake
Fires on every new Shopify order. The order is cleaned into one shape (phone, pincode, payment mode, items) and given a one-time token for the decision links.

## History & Pincode Data
Looks up this customer's past orders and returns in your sheet, and the RTO rate you've seen for this pincode.

## Courier & Address Checks
Asks Shiprocket whether couriers can deliver COD to this pincode, and checks the pincode against India Post so a city or state mismatch is caught. Either call can fail without stopping the order.

## Rule & AI Scoring
Rules score the address, history, pincode and order shape. GPT-4o-mini adds a second opinion and suggests address fixes. The two are blended, and hard red flags always mean high risk. Prepaid orders get more leeway.

## Log & Route
Every assessment is saved with its score and reasons, then the order is sent down the low, medium or high path.

## Low-Risk Release
Low-risk orders just get a tag in Shopify and ship as normal.

## Fulfilment Hold
Medium and high-risk orders have their fulfilment orders put on hold and tagged, so the warehouse can't ship them yet. The held IDs are saved for release later.

## Customer Confirmation
Medium-risk customers get a WhatsApp and email with Confirm and Cancel links, and a pay-online option.

## Manual Review
High-risk orders go to Slack with the score, reasons and Release, Cancel and Prepay buttons. The customer is told their order is being verified.

## Decision Link Check
Customer and team links arrive on one webhook. The one-time token and the order's current status are checked before anything changes.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Release, Cancel or Prepay

parameters.content:
## Release, Cancel or Prepay
Releases the fulfilment hold, cancels the order in Shopify, or sends the customer a pay-online request.

## Record & Confirm
Saves the decision, shows a confirmation page to whoever clicked, and posts it to Slack.

## Confirmation SLA
Every hour, orders still waiting on the customer are checked.

## Remind or Escalate
After 4 hours with no reply the customer gets one reminder. After 24 hours the order goes to Slack so the team can call or cancel.

## Credentials & Security
Shopify, Shiprocket and WhatsApp keys live in n8n credentials, never in nodes. Decision links are one-time and status-checked. The risk log holds customer addresses and phone numbers, so keep the sheet private.
